summary: The powershell shell plugin is the only option for winrm or psrp connections, and also works over ssh when DefaultShell is PowerShell.
questions: Which shell plugin is used with WinRM?
Can I use PowerShell over SSH with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Windows PowerShell shell plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.powershell` is the only shell for `winrm`/`psrp`, and works with `ssh` when the host's `DefaultShell` is PowerShell.
